# Historical cancellation checkpoint

These bytes were generated by the actual product at commit
`8f10a60f38692df0de7f128e6e515a99136f081a`, the parent of M125 commit
`6d60e16578f852b9c35cb8d73bcbc69b431e6d8b`.

The existing `tests/test_checkpoint_audit_outbox.py::test_crash_between_checkpoint_and_outbox_staging_replays_once`
ran on a detached scratch worktree. Its fourth case executed the former cancellation
and saved the checkpoint before the injected crash at outbox staging. A capture call
after `pytest.raises(SystemExit)` copied the producer files without parsing/rebuilding
their bytes. All four original producer cases then passed.

Evidence run: `sub369-old-capture-sandbox-5542ead5` (sub-369 report).
`manifest.json` records each relative destination, byte length, and SHA-256.
The replay fixture verifies these digests and copies the bytes unchanged into its
isolated data root. `files/** -text -diff` preserves producer bytes across Git checkouts.
No historical checkpoint or audit event was constructed by hand.

Producer files:

- `short_confirmations/168598bc42cd2431970a37462b4b8c025fef9da481f2cc333e2953c9341cf5a1.json` — SHA256 `3d6d09be75ac9ab57228c74d1430240442c46d3c4bf804e4b815fbeea0fd13bc`, 24017 bytes.
